title.narrative: Council for Development Policy in 2024 and 2025

description.narrative:
The Council for Development Policy assists the MFA by providing strategic advice to the Minister for development cooperation and global climate policy. The Council also quality assures and recommends draft projects and programmes (above DKK 43 million) and multilateral organisation strategies (above DKK 10 million) for approval by the Minister.
The grant covers expenses related to meetings in the Council for Development Policy, including transportation, accommodation, catering and remuneration to the members of the Council. Furthermore, the grant covers expenses related to a duty travel for the Council to Kenya and Ethiopia in April 2024 and a seminar for the Council in the autumn of 2024.
